title: Page config
description: The one settings block a built page carries for the viewer, in `<script type="application/json" id="page-config">`, right after the fixtures block. The tool writes it; the viewer reads it, the fixtures block, and the design in `<template id="product">`, and nothing else of the tool's. A screen's states and their order are not here: the viewer reads them from the design itself, in the order it draws them. The part "The page contract" in section 6 of `docs/tech-spec.md` describes every block and slot of the page.

schema_version.description: The version of this block's shape.

design_id.description: The id the viewer keeps this design's comments by in the browser: a hash of the design's path inside the project, so it is the same whether the page opens as a file or from the server, and on every machine that holds the project.

design.description: The design's path inside the project, with `/` between its parts, such as `design/app.html`.

product.description: The product's name, one line, for the viewer's header.

work_item.description: The work item the design names, or "" for none: any text of 1 to 64 characters with no space or control character.

platforms.description: The platforms the design declares, in its order. Each is a place a view must be seen in. Default when the design declares none: web.

themes.description: The product themes the design declares, in its order. Default when the design declares none: light.

html.description: The design's own <html> attributes, `lang` and `dir` among them, less every name with the prefix data-proto-: a frame's root takes them.

body.description: The design's own <body> attributes, less every name with the prefix data-proto-: a frame's body takes them.

tokens.description: The tokens the build places before the design's styles, in order, each with its text, for the System view: the design document's generated block first, when the project has one, then each token file. The page carries the same text in a <style data-proto-tokens> before the design.

file.description: The file's path inside the project.

design_md.description: The project's design document, or null when the project has none. Its CSS rides in `tokens` as the first entry.

frames.description: The device frames, in the order the frame menu lists them. The first frame of each platform in this list is that platform's default frame.

safe_area.description: The system bars the frame draws over the design, in CSS px; 0 and 0 for none.

flows.description: The flows the design includes, in its order; empty for a design with none.

rounds.description: The earlier rounds' comments, oldest first, each comment whole. What could not be read is a `rounds.*` finding in `findings`.

id.description: r<round>-<n>, where <round> is this round's number.

by.description: Who wrote it, such as agent:<harness>/<model>, or "" for a person.

done.description: A later round's changes answer it.

shown_theme.description: The theme the reviewer saw, or "" when the file does not say.

answered_by.description: The change that answers this comment, when one does: the first change of a later round's changes.json that names it. A comment no change answers has no such key.

summary.description: The change's summary, whole: what changed, in a sentence.

rounds_path.description: The folder that holds this design's rounds, inside the project, with `/` between its parts: `<design folder>/rounds/<design name>`, where the design name is the file's stem.

findings.description: The design's findings, as `check --json` gives them, for the page's banner, rounds' problems included as `rounds.*` findings.

file.description: The file the finding names, from the project's top; null when it has no place.

limits.description: The round files' limits, from the comments schema. The viewer counts against them and disables Save over a limit; the save refuses over them; the build leaves a round out over the page limits and says so in a `rounds.limit` finding. Nothing is cut in silence.

design_md.description: The project's design document, DESIGN.md, as the tool read it: the same shape in the page config and in `project`'s output.

file.description: The document's path, from the project's top.

version.description: The format version the document names; `alpha` when it names none.

tokens.description: Each token the document places, in the order of its lines, then each colour role that joins a light and a dark member.

path.description: The token's path in the document, such as `colors.light.surface`; a role's is `colors.<path>`.

name.description: The CSS custom property a design reads.

line.description: The token's line in the document.

light.description: The value in the light theme, every reference followed; "" when it has none. `open-prototype project` gives the value the page draws after the token files, and "" where a token file sets it in `@media` or under a selector other than the root's.

dark.description: The value in the dark theme, every reference followed; "" when it has none. `open-prototype project` gives the value the page draws after the token files, and "" where a token file sets it in `@media` or under a selector other than the root's.

components.description: Each key of the document's `components`, with its line.

sections.description: Each `##` heading of the document, with its line.

exists.description: `project` only: whether the file is there. The page config never holds it.
